description: ASEP - Balance Gral de agua potable y alc sanitario valores corrientes, hasta 2020 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Por año desde 1984. Se muestran los valores activo, pasivo y capitalización del balance general de agua potable y alcantarillado sanitario. Con datos suministrados por el prestador (IDAAN). Actualizado por ASEP hasta diciembre 2020. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are activo, agua, agua potable, aguas servidas, balance general. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2022-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
